_comment: Edit these, then run: python3 escape-room/src/build_all.py
patricia_keepsake: whatever is kept at the back of the upstairs toilet, about which a noble woman does not ask
chloe_keepsake: a potted plant, or the soil beneath it
shirley_keepsake: a bottle kept for company, in the cabinet where such bottles are kept
